pr_title: storageparams: Introduce "schema_locked" which prevents schema changes
pr_body:
We introduced a new table storage parameter "schema_locked", which, when set, prevents schema changes on that table. This parameter is only allowed to set/reset in a single-statement implicit transaction.
Note that we whitelisted certain schema change stmts (e.g. GRANT, COMMENT) so that they are allowed even if this parameter is set.

Fixes #100766
Epic: CRDB-2258
Release note: None

issue_context.title: add new storage parameter to disable schema changes (DDLs) for a particular table
issue_context.body:
We need to add a new storage parameter called `disable_schema_changes` that can be set at the table table as described in RFC [#99890](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/99890) for supporting reduced latency changefeeds. Setting this should disable any DDLs that are run against the table. DCLs (GRANT, COMMENT) should not be affected and should be allowed.

Setting:
```
ALTER TABLE t SET (disable_schema_changes=t);
```

Unsetting:
```
ALTER TABLE t SET (disable_schema_changes=f);
```
Trying to run a DDL on a table with the storage parameter should fail with an error along the lines of:
```
The storage parameter disable_schema_changes is set to true on this table, please set it to false by running 
ALTER TABLE t SET (disable_schema_changes=f); before doing a schema change.
```

Further `disable_schema_changes` should only be allowed to be set and unset by the owner of that particular table.

Jira issue: CRDB-26611


Epic CRDB-2258
